messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "edema may be most efficiently and safely mobilized by giving this drug on 2 to 4 consecutive days each week"
set: ["edema may be most efficiently and safely mobilized by giving this drug on 2 to 4 consecutive days each week", "take on 3 to 5 days each week", "doctor may start on cholesterol-lowering diet before giving drug", "remove and safely discard needle after each injection", "4 to 16 days", "1 to 4 days", "4 days", "1 to 2 week intervals", "cutting back on fluid and salt has not been enough to treat this edema", "use an injection on the same day each week", "this applies to most brands of levothyroxine", "may take 1 to 4 days before symptoms improve", "600 mg orally once each morning on days 1 to 3", "may take 1 to 4 days to reach its full effect", "stop taking prednisone safely by tapering dose", "this diuretic holds on to potassium"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
